screening.reason: Meets inclusion 2/3: analyses ABIDE I and ABIDE II fMRI data directly (as image slices) to classify ASD vs non-ASD, i.e. a diagnostic-prediction analysis, not just a citation or structural/DTI/phenotype-only use.

evidence_spans.text:
ABIDE I dataset consists of 1112 
total samples including 539 patients and 573 typical 
controls (TC) subjects. While ABIDE II dataset consists 
of 1114 total samples with 521 patients and 573 
typical controls (TC) subjects.
evidence_spans.claim: The study used the full ABIDE I (1112) and ABIDE II (1114) releases, 539/573 and 521/573 ASD/TD respectively.

evidence_spans.text:
The original format of the image dataset is NIfTI-1 
data format file (NII format) which is in 3-Dimensional 
(3D) form. MRIcron software was used to convert the 
3D data format into 2D data images.
evidence_spans.claim: Raw 3D NIfTI volumes were converted to 2D images with MRIcron rather than processed through a connectivity pipeline.

evidence_spans.text:
In this research, the axial plane is used 
as the input samples.
evidence_spans.claim: A single axial-plane 2D slice per subject was used as the CNN input, not a connectivity matrix.

evidence_spans.text:
The samples were separated into two folders 
which were the training file and test file.
evidence_spans.claim: Evaluation used a single train/test split with no cross-validation scheme described.

evidence_spans.text:
The results achieved using CNN models namely 
VGG-16 and ResNet-50 are 63.4% and 87.0% accuracy, respectively.
evidence_spans.claim: VGG-16 reached 63.4% and ResNet-50 reached 87.0% test accuracy classifying ASD vs non-ASD.

evidence_spans.text:
The best CNN model in this project was 
achieved by ResNet50, with an accuracy of 87.0%.
evidence_spans.claim: ResNet-50 was identified as the best-performing model at 87.0% accuracy.

evidence_spans.text:
The performance of the CNN pre-trained model was 
evaluated using several measurements such as 
recall, precision, and accuracy.
evidence_spans.claim: Performance was evaluated with recall, precision and accuracy only (no AUC, no uncertainty estimate).

assessments.support: N by diagnosis given for ABIDE I and II, but no inclusion/exclusion criteria, QC rule or site list reported beyond the raw release counts: "ABIDE I dataset consists of 1112 total samples including 539 patients and 573 typical controls (TC) subjects."

Predictor is a single 2D axial-plane slice converted from the 3D NIfTI volume with no connectivity pipeline, atlas or feature-extraction method reported: "MRIcron software was used to convert the  3D data format into 2D data images."
Diagnostic label (Autism/Non-Autism) is the ABIDE phenotypic diagnosis, assigned independently of the image-based predictor.

Single train/test split, no cross-validation, no leave-site-out evaluation, and only point-estimate accuracy/recall/precision with no uncertainty reported: "The samples were separated into two folders  which were the training file and test file."

risk_of_bias.summary: Full ABIDE I+II release used as raw counts with no QC/exclusion rule; features are a single 2D brain-plane slice per subject with no connectivity pipeline or atlas; evaluation is a single train/test split with point-estimate accuracy only and no site handling.

items.support: N by diagnosis given for both releases but no inclusion/exclusion rule.
No connectivity preprocessing pipeline; only slice-conversion software named.
Diagnosis is the ABIDE phenotypic label; source/criteria not restated in this paper.
No site handling or leave-site-out evaluation.
No code or participant-list availability statement.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction; ABIDE I+II full releases, 539/573 (ASD/TD) and 521/573 (ASD/TD) respectively, ages 5-64, sites not itemised.
narrative_row.methods: 3D NIfTI volumes converted to 2D axial-plane image slices (MRIcron) and classified with pre-trained CNNs (VGG-16, ResNet-50) using a single train/test split.
narrative_row.outcomes: ResNet-50 achieved 87.0% test accuracy (best model); VGG-16 achieved 63.4%; evaluated with accuracy, recall and precision.
narrative_row.key_limitations: No motion/QC rule, no connectivity pipeline or atlas, no cross-validation or site handling, and no participant-list/code availability statement.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Demonstrates ABIDE I+II used as raw image data for a non-connectivity CNN classifier; cohort cannot be reconstructed beyond the aggregate N reported.

kg_link.cohort_description: Full ABIDE I (1112: 539 ASD/573 TD) and ABIDE II (1114: 521 ASD/573 TD) releases, ages 5-64; no further exclusion rule stated.
kg_link.finding: ResNet-50 achieved 87.0% test accuracy classifying ASD vs non-ASD from 2D axial brain-image slices, outperforming VGG-16 (63.4%).
